title: Status of child.
bodyText: For purposes of proceedings under this chapter and adoption proceedings, a newborn child left at a hospital, fire station, or police station, or with emergency services personnel under section 587D-2 shall be considered an abandoned child.
bodyHtml: [§587D-7]  Status of child.  For purposes of proceedings under this chapter and adoption proceedings, a newborn child left at a hospital, fire station, or police station, or with emergency services personnel under section 587D‑2 shall be considered an abandoned child. [L Sp 2007, c 7, pt of §2]
